Dadi ne poocha: "Behosh karke aap chali toh nahi jaayengi?" 😟
Dr Saathi ne kaha: nahi Dadi! Poore operation mein main aapke paas rahungi. 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Anaesthesia doctor ya unki team poore operation mein aapke paas rehti hai
✅ BP, dil ki dhadkan, oxygen aur saans machine par lagataar dekhe jaate hain
✅ Dawa ki maatra zaroorat ke hisaab se sahi rakhi jaati hai, taaki aap aaraam se aur surakshit rahein
✅ Operation ke baad recovery room mein bhi aapka dhyaan rakha jaata hai
Koi bhi sawaal ho, apne doctor se poochhiye.
